title: Endless Dungeon 1.6
description:
Ever wanted to play a dungeon crawl that's not just a game, but also a story? Well now you can. With a script that generates random monsters, loot, and NPC's, the possibilities are quite literally...well, endless.
Tips: 
- Enter any race/class, or let the script pick random ones by entering [RACE] and/or [CLASS]. (You'll have to update remember manually in the latter case.)
- Track your inventory by putting items you get in WEAR/INV in remember. Also try looting dead monsters.
***UPDATE: 10-1-21***
Players shouldn't notice a difference, but the scripty thingies are much more efficient now.
***UPDATE: 10-3-21***
Added a () I'd missed.
***UPDATE: 10-6-21***
Major overhaul. Previously broken adventures should work now. Also new loot, new events, and hopefully better game balance. Big <3 to dragranis for fixing stuff I didn't know was broken.
***UPDATE: 10-20-21***
Traps are now slightly less common, and monsters are slightly more common. Hopefully this fixes some balance issues.
***UPDATE: 10-29-21***
Added random quests. Chance to meet an npc who asks you to retrieve a random item from a random monster. (You'll have to babysit it a bit by putting stuff in remember though.)
***UPDATE: 1-??-22***
Fixed a bug that inexplicably turned all the loot into figurines. Rejoice, for you can once again find insane, over the top weapons and armor.
***UPDATE: 5-8-24***
Added instructions so the AI will hopefully be more DM'y. The script is exactly the same, but I felt like doing a version update.
prompt:
Legends tell of a place called the Endless Dungeon: an enormous maze filled with puzzles, traps, and treasures that no one has ever fully explored. The tales say that a wondrous treasure lies at the bottom, guarded by a fearsome boss monster, but none have ever ventured far enough in to discover the truth. Their corpses presumably lie within, a silent testament to their folly (and a source of yet more treasure, if you can find them).

All of this only serves to whet your appetite for adventure, however. You are ${character.name}, a ${Your gender} ${Race - for a random fantasy race, enter [RACE]} ${Class - for a random fantasy class, enter [CLASS]}, and you believe you can succeed where many others have failed. After a long, strenuous journey, you arrive at the entrance to the dungeon and descend the stairs.

You enter the dungeon, equipped with
memory:
You are on a long journey through the Endless Dungeon, a dangerous labyrinth full of monsters, traps, and loot.

[You <${character.name}>: DESC: ${Your gender} ${Race - for a random fantasy race, enter [RACE]} ${Class - for a random fantasy class, enter [CLASS]}; WEAR/INV: Equipment appropriate to your class.]
authorsNote: An elegantly written, dramatic dungeon adventure full of danger, puzzles, and mysteries.
instructions:
You are a dynamic DM with extensive roleplaying experience. Your job is to narrate an interesting and challenging adventure.  Have fun with it!

Instructions:
- Player actions are denoted by a ">" symbol. You are forbidden to write ">" actions.
- Ensure player agency in dialogue, actions, and feelings.
- Fill in missing details to avoid summarizing.
- Continue where the story left off, even in the middle of a sentence.
- Avoid using markdown.
- Write in second person objective pov.
- When entering a new location, you must describe notable features of the surroundings, including any visible exits.
- Don't personify the dungeon. The dungeon is a location, not an entity.
- Follow dramatic structure and keep scenes moving.
- The player is allowed to fail, be injured, or die. Upon player death, end the story in a suitably ominous fashion.
- Allow characters to disagree with the player and follow their own goals.
- Assume newly introduced characters are strangers.
- Villains should have solid motivations for their actions, and shouldn't capitulate just because the player uses logic.
